headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 299.7 Million Dollars From 183.9 Million, Led By Deribit And OKX
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to a 299.7 million dollar inflow, 0.1096 percent of the 273.5 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from an 183.9 million dollar inflow at 0.0673 percent. Deribit took in 197.9 million dollars and OKX took in 196.2 million dollars, while Gate took in 171.7 million dollars and Binance posted a 226.8 million dollar outflow. The pipe measures the 24-hour change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the higher inflow means more clean-asset value arrived than left, and the arrivals at Deribit, OKX, and Gate outweighed the departure from Binance.
author: jordan
